name: send_media
description: Remote transport: use chunked uploads for large attachments. Send an image, video, audio or document up to 500 MB. For larger attachments, use create_media_upload and upload_media_chunk, then pass fileId. Small payloads may use base64 directly (8 MB inline transport budget). Never supply a filesystem path or URL.

name: read_media

name: analyze_media
description: Choose a local fallback when your AI client cannot interpret an attachment. Starts an asynchronous job: auto selects transcription for audio, visual analysis plus transcript for video, description for images, or document text extraction. Choose cache to download a large attachment in the background without running a model, then transfer its fileId using read_media_chunk. Other modes: transcribe, frames, analyze, ocr, extract. Poll get_media_analysis. Sources up to 500 MB; no paid APIs.
